lines.en: label yumichikaspecial1:
scene chikayakuza1
: Get your fucking hands off of me you infertile, small-dicked piece of shit!
lines.zh: : 把你他妈的手从我身上拿开，你这个断子绝孙的小鸡巴废物！

lines.en: : Think you’re fucking tough because you can hold back a teenage girl?! Take me on by yourself and see how it goes, asshole! I will fucking end you!
lines.zh: : 觉得能按住一个女高中生就牛逼了是吧？！有种你一个人跟我打，看看到底怎么样，混蛋！我他妈弄死你！

lines.en: : For the love of God, stop yelling. How many times do we have to tell you you’re not allowed here?
lines.zh: : 老天爷啊，别喊了。我们要跟你说多少遍你不准进这儿？

lines.en: : I don’t answer to you, dickbag! Let me talk to whoever is in charge!
lines.zh: : 我凭什么听你的，傻屌！让我跟管事的说话！

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s...not gonna happen.
lines.zh: : 呃，那个……不太行。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza2
: Oh, and look at you! Imagine being so fucking worthless that you’re the number two to a nobody like the {i}other{/i} fucking idiot holding me back! Suck my dick, you little bitch!
lines.zh: : 哦，还有你看看你！得废物到什么程度，才会去给{i}另一个{/i}按住我的白痴当二把手！去你妈的，小逼崽子！

lines.en: : Don’t listen to her, Gary. You’re a great guy and she doesn’t know what she’s talking about.
lines.zh: : 别听她的，Gary。你是个好人，她根本不知道自己在说什么。

lines.en: : Fuck you, Gary! Fuck you to Hell!
lines.zh: : 去你的，Gary！滚去地狱吧！

lines.en: : Wha-?! What the fuck is going on over here?!
lines.zh: : 啥——？！这边到底怎么回事？！

lines.en: scene chikayakuza3
: Yumi! Thank God! Get these fucking goons off of me!
lines.zh: : Yumi！谢天谢地！把这些傻逼打手从我身上弄走！

lines.en: : Chika?! What the fuck are you doing here?!
lines.zh: : Chika？！你他妈在这儿干什么？！

lines.en: : Oh, you know! Just being held back by two limp-dicked Yakuza who think they’re hot shit because they can restrain one whole girl if they work together!
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的！就是被两个软屌黑帮按着，他们还因为两个人合力才勉强制住一个女生就觉得自己牛逼得不行！

lines.en: : Okay. In our defense, you are freakishly strong.
lines.zh: : 好吧。说句公道话，你力气大得吓人。

lines.en: : Fuck you, Gary! Yumi, help!
lines.zh: : 去你的，Gary！Yumi，救命！

lines.en: scene chikayakuza4
: Yo! Get your hands off of her! She ain’t here to cause trouble!
lines.zh: : 喂！把你们的手松开！她不是来闹事的！

lines.en: : But...Ojou-sama, she burst through the gates and wouldn’t even tell us-
lines.zh: : 可是……大小姐，她是冲过大门闯进来的，连句话都不肯说——

lines.en: : I don’t give a shit what she did! I said she’s alright and that means you let her the fuck go! Got it?!
lines.zh: : 她干了什么我他妈一点都不在乎！我说了她没问题，那就意味着你们他妈的给我放人！听懂了吗？！

lines.en: : It makes sense that this girl is a friend of the princess with how strong she is.
lines.zh: : 这姑娘力气这么大，是公主的朋友也说得通。

lines.en: : Ojou-sama...has a friend?...
lines.zh: : 大小姐……有朋友？……

lines.en: : She’s all grown up now...
lines.zh: : 她真是长大了啊……

lines.en: : If I have to ask again, I’m taking both of your pinkies!
lines.zh: : 要是让我再说一遍，我就把你们俩的小指都剁了！

lines.en: scene black
: Yes, Ojou-sama!
lines.zh: : 是，大小姐！

lines.en: scene chikayakuza5
: Gago! Supot! Putang ina mo! Kainin mo tae ko!
lines.zh: : Gago! Supot! Putang ina mo! Kainin mo tae ko!

lines.en: : Jesus. You must be {i}really{/i} pissed off if you’re breaking out the Tagalog.
lines.zh: : 天哪。你连他加禄语都搬出来了，得气成{i}什么样{/i}。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza6
: I only remember the bad words...
lines.zh: : 我只记得脏话……

lines.en: : I swear to fucking God, Yumi. If those assholes messed up my wrist and I can’t use it for...stuff anymore, {i}I’m{/i} going to take their pinkies.
lines.zh: : 我他妈对天发誓，Yumi。要是那群混蛋弄伤了我的手腕，害我以后没法用那手办事了，{i}我就{/i}去剁了他们的小指。

lines.en: : Do you...need ice or some shit?
lines.zh: : 你……要不要冰块什么的？

lines.en: scene chikayakuza7
: Hah...no. I’ll be fine in a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 哈……不用。我过几分钟就没事了。

lines.en: : {i}Gary{/i} bent the fucking “T” on my bracelet, though.
lines.zh: : 不过 {i}Gary{/i} 把我手镯上那个「T」字给掰弯了，操。

lines.en: : Just wear the gold one instead. You have two, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 那就戴金的那条呗。你有两条，不是吗？

lines.en: scene chikayakuza8
: Gold?! With this outfit?! Are you fucking kidding me?!
lines.zh: : 金的？！配这身衣服？！你他妈在开玩笑吗？！

lines.en: : Also, where the fuck have you been?!
lines.zh: : 还有，你他妈到底跑哪儿去了？！

lines.en: : Uhh...h...here?
lines.zh: : 呃……呃……这儿？

lines.en: : Why?!
lines.zh: : 为什么？！

lines.en: : Because, uhh...ain’t you, like...mad at me and shit?
lines.zh: : 因为，呃……你不是……在生我的气什么的吗？

lines.en: scene chikayakuza9
: Why would that even matter?! You always said you’d rather rot in the street than come back here!
lines.zh: : 那又有什么关系？！你以前不是一直说宁可在街上烂死也不肯回这儿吗！

lines.en: : If I knew you were back at your dad’s the whole fucking time, I wouldn’t have had to run all over the place looking for you!
lines.zh: : 我要是知道你一直待在你爸这儿，我也不用满世界跑着找你了！

lines.en: : You...kinda didn’t have to, you know.
lines.zh: : 你……其实没必要，你知道的。

lines.en: : What the fuck do you mean “I didn’t have to?”
lines.zh: : 「没必要」你他妈什么意思？

lines.en: scene chikayakuza10
: Well...you saw what went down. And then you said that shit about Chinami and...
lines.zh: : 那个……你都看见了当时发生了什么。然后你又说了关于 Chinami 的那些话，还有……

lines.en: : I just...figured that meant you didn’t want me around anymore...and shit.
lines.zh: : 我就……觉得那意思是你不想要我在身边了……之类的。

lines.en: : So what? You thought I was just never going to see you again because you beat the crap out of one girl?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？你以为就因为你把某个女生揍得稀烂，我就再也不见你了？

lines.en: : After all the shit I’ve done for you...and all the times I’ve stood up for you...you think {i}one{/i} thing will just make me go, “Welp. Yumi sucks. Guess my best friend is Chinami now?”
lines.zh: : 我为你做了那么多事……那么多次站出来为你说话……你觉得就因为{i}一件{/i}事我就会说「好吧。Yumi 烂透了。看来我最好的朋友现在是 Chinami 了」？

lines.en: : I got no fuckin’ clue, Chika. All that shit happened so fuckin’ fast that I didn’t know what to do or where to go.
lines.zh: : 我他妈一点头绪都没有，Chika。那一切发生得太他妈快了，我根本不知道该怎么办、该去哪儿。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza11
: I didn’t {i}want{/i} to come back here. Made me feel like a fuckin’ failure.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}想{/i}回这儿。那让我觉得自己是个失败者。

lines.en: : Livin’ on the streets is...sketchy, though. Gives me the fuckin’ creeps. Couldn’t even get to sleep cause I always felt like somebody was watchin’ me.
lines.zh: : 可露宿街头又……太不靠谱了。让我他妈浑身发毛。连觉都睡不着，总觉得有人在盯着我。

lines.en: : All you had to do was talk to me.
lines.zh: : 你只要跟我说一声就好了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...you know I ain’t that good at that either.
lines.zh: : 是，嗯……你也知道我不太擅长这个。

lines.en: : Least nobody asks me shit here. And I’ve got a bed and...all the food I can fuckin’ eat too.
lines.zh: : 至少在这儿没人问我这问那。而且我有一张床，还有……吃不完的东西。

lines.en: : So...I came all the way here for nothing and you’re just going to ghost on {i}me{/i} now?
lines.zh: : 所以……我大老远跑来是白跑一趟，你现在就要这么对{i}我{/i}玩消失？

lines.en: scene chikayakuza12
: It ain’t like that.
lines.zh: : 不是那么回事。

lines.en: : Then tell me what it’s like, Yumi. Because I’ve seen you do a ton of crazy shit before, but never anything like that. That was a new level of anger that I...I wasn’t ready for yet.
lines.zh: : 那你说说是怎么回事，Yumi。我见过你干过一大堆疯事，但从来没有像这次这样的。那是我不曾……还没准备好面对的全新级别的愤怒。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza13
: And yet you were about to kill two Yamaguchi officers just now.
lines.zh: : 可你刚才差点就要干掉两个山口组的干部了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well they picked a fight with the wrong bitch and I will fucking cut anyone who stands between me and what I love.
lines.zh: : 是，那他们挑错了人。凡是挡在我和我所爱之人之间的，我都他妈会砍了。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza14
: That’s what I’ve always liked about you.
lines.zh: : 我一直喜欢你就是这点。

lines.en: : Is it? You didn’t just stick around for fashion tips?
lines.zh: : 是吗？你留在我身边不只是为了穿搭建议？

lines.en: scene chikayakuza15
: Speaking of which, your boobs look great in that top. You’re not still wrapping them, are you?
lines.zh: : 说到这个，你穿这件上衣胸型很好看。你没再缠了吧？

lines.en: : Is that...really what we’re gonna talk about?
lines.zh: : 这……我们真要聊这个？

lines.en: : Well, are you actually going to talk about what I {i}came{/i} here to talk about? Or are you going to be a fucking lonely cunt like always and try to figure {i}this{/i} out on your own as well?
lines.zh: : 那，你到底要不要谈我{i}来这儿{/i}要谈的事？还是你又要像往常一样当个孤独的臭婊子，一个人闷头想明白？

lines.en: scene chikayakuza16

: I don’t fuckin’ know, Chika. But can we at least sit down if we’re gonna talk about this shit? Barely slept at all last night and my legs are fuckin’ killing me from doin’ so many laps around this place.
lines.zh: : 我他妈不知道，Chika。不过要聊这个能不能至少坐下来？昨晚基本没怎么睡，在这地方绕了那么多圈，我腿都他妈快断了。

lines.en: : Depends on if your goons are going to assault me again for setting foot on their beloved walkway.
lines.zh: : 那得看你的手下会不会因为我又踩上他们那条宝贝步道而再揍我一顿。

lines.en: : They’ll do whatever the fuck I tell ‘em to. I’m still the boss’s daughter even if I ain’t been here in a hot minute.
lines.zh: : 我让他们干什么他们就他妈干什么。就算我很久没回来，我照样是老板的女儿。

lines.en: : Okay. But if I so much as {i}see{/i} Gary again, I swear to fucking God.
lines.zh: : 好。但我要是再{i}看见{/i} Gary 一眼，我他妈对天发誓。

lines.en: : Gary really ain’t that bad. He’s one of the good ones.
lines.zh: : Gary 真没那么坏。他算好的那类。

lines.en: : Gary can go to Hell.
lines.zh: : Gary 下地狱去吧。

lines.en: scene black
scene chikayakuza17
Through openings in the wood, the sun beats down on the backs of two girls who may {i}appear{/i} to be close at the moment, but could not be any further away when you really start to think about it.
lines.zh: 透过木板的缝隙，阳光照在两个女孩的背上——此刻{i}看上去{/i}她们或许很亲近，可真要认真想一想，她们之间却再遥远不过了。

lines.en: This is speaking figuratively, of course. But given the amount of exposure you’ve had to these long-winded ramblings of mine, I’m sure I don’t have to tell you that.
lines.zh: 这当然是比喻。不过，考虑到你已经听了这么多我这种啰嗦的长篇大论，我想我也用不着说明。

lines.en: The one on the right wants to know everything.
lines.zh: 右边那个想知道一切。

lines.en: She wants to know why a girl she believed was getting better relapsed.
lines.zh: 她想知道，一个她以为正在好转的女孩为什么会旧态复发。

lines.en: She can’t help but draw parallels to her best friend’s mother and how things like that might just run in the family.
lines.zh: 她忍不住把她和她最好朋友的母亲联系起来，想着这种事说不定会遗传。

lines.en: But those are thoughts she hates herself for having.
lines.zh: 但这些念头让她恨透了自己。

lines.en: The one on the left just wants it all to stop.
lines.zh: 左边那个只想让一切停下来。

lines.en: She doesn’t want to talk about this. But, at the same time, she doesn’t regret anything at all.
lines.zh: 她不想谈这个。但与此同时，她一点也不后悔。

lines.en: She, too, draws parallels to her mother. It’s all too easy when the lines outstretch toward her and her alone.
lines.zh: 她同样把她和自己的母亲联系在一起。当所有的线都朝她一个人伸过来时，这再容易不过了。

lines.en: She thinks that maybe this is all she’s good for...and that the idea of ever trying to fit in or survive outside of these walls in the first place was nothing short of a pipe dream.
lines.zh: 她想，也许这就是她唯一擅长的了……而当初想要融入、想要在这些高墙之外活下去的念头，简直就是一场白日梦。

lines.en: if yumiknows == False:
But more than that, she’s worried the truth will get out.
lines.zh: 但更让她担心的是，真相会泄露出去。

lines.en: She’s worried that it won’t just stop at what happened in the locker room-
lines.zh: 她担心事情不会只停在更衣室里发生的那件事上——

lines.en: But that revealing the true nature of that unfortunate night will open the flood gates and she won’t be able to hold back everything {i}else{/i} that’s happened.
lines.zh: 她担心一旦说出那个不幸之夜的真相，闸门就会打开，她将再也拦不住之后发生的{i}其他{/i}一切。

lines.en: She won’t be able to hold back how unclean it all feels.
lines.zh: 她将再也拦不住这一切有多么肮脏的感觉。

lines.en: Or how she’s still too curious to just rinse it all off.
lines.zh: 也拦不住自己依然好奇得不肯把这一切冲洗干净。

lines.en: else:
But more than that...she’s worried about hurting her one and only friend-
lines.zh: 但更重要的是……她怕伤到她唯一的朋友——

lines.en: And that confessing to what happened in the locker room on that unfortunate night will snowball into something that could result in more than just the shattering of herself.
lines.zh: 也怕坦白那个不幸之夜在更衣室里发生的事会像滚雪球一样，最终不止是把自己碾碎。

lines.en: The girl on the left knows for certain of the futility of the love her best friend pursues.
lines.zh: 左边的女孩清楚，她最好的朋友所追逐的那份爱注定徒劳。

lines.en: But her desire to see an honest smile on a bronze tinted face outweighs her desire to rid herself of the scattered impurities brought to light by someone who had it out for her.
lines.zh: 但她想在那张晒成古铜色的脸上看到一个真诚的笑容，这份渴望压过了她想清除那些被处处针对她的人抖出来的、斑驳污点的渴望。

lines.en: And deep down, she can’t help but feel as if she deserved it.
lines.zh: 而在内心深处，她忍不住觉得自己是活该。

lines.en: : Have you talked to your dad at all?
lines.zh: : 你跟你爸谈过了吗？

lines.en: : For a minute or two. But it was the same old shit it’s always been. Dude’s still an asshole. But he’s an asshole with a house and I kinda figured I didn’t have a place to go anymore.
lines.zh: : 聊了一两分钟。不过还是老样子。那家伙依然是个混蛋。但好歹是个有房子的混蛋，而且我有点觉得自己已经没地方可去了。

lines.en: : Ain’t even allowed to come get my shit at the dorms since it’s technically school property. But I guess it ain’t like I’ve got much there to begin with.
lines.zh: : 连宿舍里的东西都不准去拿，因为严格来说那是学校的财产。不过反正我本来也没多少东西在那儿。

lines.en: : Anybody else here able to...you know...help get your mind off of stuff? Any of those guys you used to hang around with?
lines.zh: : 这儿还有别人能……你知道的……帮你转移一下注意力吗？你以前混的那帮人呢？

lines.en: : Nah. Heard a few of ‘em died from some of the older guys who are still here, though. Sucks.
lines.zh: : 没。不过从还在这儿的老前辈那儿听说，有几个死了。真惨。

lines.en: : So you’ve just been...wandering around all sad and lonely this whole time?
lines.zh: : 所以你这段时间就一直……一个人伤心又孤独地到处晃？

lines.en: scene chikayakuza18
: It ain’t been that bad. At the very least, I can be alone here. And nobody’s ever gonna start shit with me.
lines.zh: : 也没那么糟。至少在这儿我能一个人待着。而且永远没人会来找我麻烦。

lines.en: : Still would’ve been nice to have you here, though. One of the very few people that hasn’t really pissed me off yet.
lines.zh: : 不过要是你也在就好了。你是极少数还没真的惹毛过我的人之一。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza19
: Okay, now you’re straight up lying because I know for a fact that I piss you off every single morning.
lines.zh: : 好了，你现在纯属在撒谎——我可清楚得很，我每天早上都把你气得半死。

lines.en: : Yeah, but there’s a big difference between pissing me off because you take six hours to get ready and, like...{i}actually{/i} pissing me off.
lines.zh: : 是，可你为了出门要花六个小时才把我惹毛，和……{i}真的{/i}把我惹毛，差别大了去了。

lines.en: : Beauty doesn’t come without its setbacks, Yumi. Just because it takes you five minutes to get ready doesn’t mean we can all be that lucky.
lines.zh: : 美丽总是有代价的，Yumi。你五分钟就能出门，不代表我们都能有那份运气。

lines.en: : Heh...me...lucky. That’s rich.
lines.zh: : 呵……我……运气好。这话可真新鲜。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza20
: Are you gonna tell me what happened?
lines.zh: : 你打算告诉我发生什么了吗？

lines.en: : You saw what happened.
lines.zh: : 你不是都看见了。

lines.en: : Ooookay. Then, are you going to tell me {i}why{/i} it happened?
lines.zh: : 好好好。那，你打算告诉我{i}为什么{/i}会那样吗？

lines.en: : Yumi, do you really think I would have trespassed on Yakuza turf and fought off two thugs if I didn’t want to be on your side? Fuck no.
lines.zh: : Yumi，你真觉得我要不是站在你这边，会闯进黑帮的地盘、还跟两个打手动手？想都别想。

lines.en: : I’m basically dying for a reason to go to bat for you right now. But shit like “Oh, you guys just don’t understand her!” isn’t going to work this time.
lines.zh: : 我现在简直是拼命想找个理由为你出头。但这次「哦，你们根本不了解她！」这种话可不管用。

lines.en: : Nodoka was {i}fucked up{/i} for like a whole week. I’m surprised she came out of that without a concussion.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 差不多整整一个星期都{i}没缓过来{/i}。她能没被打成脑震荡就算奇迹了。

lines.en: : How about everybody else?
lines.zh: : 其他人呢？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : What are {i}they{/i} sayin’ about me?
lines.zh: : {i}他们{/i}都在怎么说我？

lines.en: scene chikayakuza21
: If you need to “go to bat” for me...it’s probably pretty bad, huh?
lines.zh: : 如果你需要「为我出头」……那情况估计挺糟的吧？

lines.en: : It’s...uhh...
: It’s definitely...not good...
lines.zh: : 确实……不太好……

lines.en: : Your reputation kinda sucked to begin with and beating a genius unconscious while she was trying to teach the nicest girl in the class math is...not a good look.
lines.zh: : 你的名声本来就够烂了，而且在全班最温柔的女生教她数学的时候，把那个天才打到昏迷……这形象可不怎么好看。

lines.en: : Figured.
lines.zh: : 猜到了。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza22
: But, Yumi! You-
lines.zh: : 可是，Yumi！你——

lines.en: : Maybe I just felt like beatin’ the shit out of her, Chika?
lines.zh: : 也许我就是想把她往死里揍一顿呢，Chika？

lines.en: : But, that...
lines.zh: : 可那……

lines.en: : No way. That wouldn’t make any sense.
lines.zh: : 不可能。说不通。

lines.en: : Why not? Bullied Futaba from the moment I met her. Tons of other people too.
lines.zh: : 为什么不可能？我从认识 Futaba 那天起就一直在欺负她。还有一大堆别的人。

lines.en: : Still talk mad shit on Sensei and you guys are basically attached at the hip now.
lines.zh: : 我现在照样天天狂喷 Sensei，可你们现在跟他黏得跟连体婴似的。

lines.en: : Maybe I just ain’t a good person?
lines.zh: : 也许我本来就不是什么好人？

lines.en: : Yeah...maybe you’re not. But you’re also not the type of person to just do shit like that without a reason.
lines.zh: : 是……也许你不是。但你也不是那种毫无理由就干出这种事的人。

lines.en: : You also thought I wasn’t the type of person to come back {i}here{/i} of all places and I didn’t even last one day out on the streets.
lines.zh: : 你还说我不是那种会回{i}这种地方{/i}的人呢，结果我连在街上待一天都没撑住。

lines.en: : Yumi-
lines.zh: : Yumi——

lines.en: : People change, Chika. You gotta remember where I come from.
lines.zh: : 人是会变的，Chika。你得记住我是从哪儿来的。

lines.en: : I’m the daughter of a Yakuza boss and a junkie. Ain’t exactly the model family a lot of other people grow up with.
lines.zh: : 我是黑帮老大和瘾君子的女儿。可不是很多人成长时的那种模范家庭。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza23
: Why are you hiding this from {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你为什么要把这事瞒着{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: : Who says I’m hiding anything?
lines.zh: : 谁说我瞒着什么了？

lines.en: : You think I don’t understand your stupid mannerisms by now? How you always look away and drop your voice whenever you’re trying to keep something a secret?
lines.zh: : 你以为到现在我还看不懂你那些蠢习惯吗？每次想瞒着什么，你都会移开视线、压低声音。

lines.en: : Did I fuck up guessing where you went? Yeah. Yeah, I did. But I was also holding out hope that you were going to come back to {i}my{/i} family before the one you left to try and become a better {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 猜错你去了哪儿？是，我是猜错了。可我也一直抱着希望，盼着你会先回{i}我家{/i}，而不是回这个{i}你{/i}当初为了重新开始而离开的地方。

lines.en: : Chinami is worried sick. We want you back.
lines.zh: : Chinami 担心坏了。我们想你回来。

lines.en: : But right now, what I want more than anything is to understand what happened to you so you don’t just...lose all of the progress you’ve made.
lines.zh: : 但现在，我最想要的，是弄明白你到底怎么了，好让你别……把好不容易取得的进步全丢光。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza24
: Honestly, Chika...{i}fuck{/i} progress. The hell was I going to get out of that anyway?
lines.zh: : 说实话，Chika……{i}去他妈的{/i}进步。反正我又能从中得到什么？

lines.en: : Ain’t like I was tryin’ to make friends or something. If anything, I don’t even know if I’d call any of that “progress” since I was just...backtracking on all of the bad shit I’ve done.
lines.zh: : 我又不是在试着交朋友什么的。要说有什么的话，我甚至不觉得那能叫「进步」——我只是……在往回撤，把以前干过的坏事一件件退回去而已。

lines.en: : No reason to clap and cheer for me for finally turning around when I’ve been runnin’ the race in the wrong direction my whole life. Might as well just...quit and save myself the embarrassment, you know?
lines.zh: : 我一辈子都在朝反方向赛跑，现在终于掉头了，根本没理由为我鼓掌叫好。不如干脆……退赛算了，也省得丢人现眼，你懂吧？

lines.en: : I don’t...but I’m going to clap and cheer for you any chance I get since you’re my best friend. I just wish you’d trust me enough to confide in me.
lines.zh: : 我不懂……但只要你是我最好的朋友，我一有机会就会为你鼓掌叫好。我只是希望你能信任我，把心里话说给我听。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza25
: Course I trust you. Maybe I just don’t want you catchin’ a murder charge and leaving the twerp all on her own when she’s already lost everybody else?
lines.zh: : 我当然信任你。也许我只是不想让你背上谋杀的罪名，留下那个小不点孤零零一个人——她已经失去了其他所有人。

lines.en: : A...murder charge? Just what the fuck happened?
lines.zh: : 谋……谋杀罪？到底他妈发生了什么？

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter. It’s in the past now.
lines.zh: : 不重要。都过去了。

lines.en: : So my reputation is dead in the water. Big deal. Ain’t like I’m ever comin’ back to school in the first place.
lines.zh: : 所以我的名声已经彻底完蛋了。没什么大不了的。反正我本来也没打算回学校。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza26
: What do you mean “ever?”
lines.zh: : 「本来」什么意思？

lines.en: : Were you actually expelled? Because word around the school is that you’re just indefinitely suspended. Which means that there’s still hope for-
lines.zh: : 你真被开除了？因为学校里的传言是你只是被无限期停学。也就是说还有希望——

lines.en: : Think I’m just gonna drop out.
lines.zh: : 我想直接退学吧。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza27
: What?...
: Let’s be real. I never fit in there anyway. And if we had any other teacher, I probably would’ve been kicked out already.
lines.zh: : 说实话。反正我在那儿从来就格格不入。要是换个别的老师，我可能早就被踢出去了。

lines.en: : But...no. No, I can’t let you do that. You always talk about how you want to make something of yourself and...and if you’re dropping out...what are you going to do instead? What does that mean for us?
lines.zh: : 可是……不。不行，我不能让你这么做。你总说想活出点样子来，可……可你要是退学了……你以后要干什么？那我们怎么办？

lines.en: : For us? Not much. If you ain’t scared of me after almost killin’ Nodoka and shit, I’m happy to keep bein’ friends with you.
lines.zh: : 我们？没什么影响。你要是在我差点把 Nodoka 打死之后还不怕我，我很乐意继续和你做朋友。

lines.en: : But for {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 但对{i}我{/i}来说？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : Maybe I’ll hang out here for a while? Give the whole Yakuza princess shit a spin and see how that goes.
lines.zh: : 也许我会在这儿待一阵子？把「黑帮公主」这套玩意儿试一试，看看到底怎么样。

lines.en: : That’s...
: But that’s...the exact opposite of what you’ve been trying to do this whole time.
lines.zh: : 可那……跟你这一路以来一直想做的完全相反。

lines.en: : It is, ain’t it?
lines.zh: : 是啊，不是吗？

lines.en: : Means it might actually work.
lines.zh: : 说明说不定真能行。

lines.en: : Besides, as long as I don’t end up like my mom, I think I’ll be able to call my life a success. And I ain’t anywhere near {i}that{/i} bad yet.
lines.zh: : 再说，只要我最后别变成我妈那样，我觉得我这一辈子就算成功了。而我离{i}那{/i}还差得远呢。

lines.en: scene chikayakuza28
: Hey now. I’ve been gettin’ a hell of a lot better, you know.
lines.zh: : 哎，我说。我可是已经好太多了，你知道吗。
